fields.Name: T20 - Dashboard Browser
fields.Description: Dashboard browser renders; accepts populated or empty dashboards.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to the Data Explorer application and open the Dashboards section. Verify the Dashboards browser renders. If dashboards exist, open one and verify it displays (its panels/widgets, OR a valid 'No parts configured' empty-state). If no dashboards exist, a clean empty browser state is acceptable. A populated dashboard OR a valid empty-state is a pass; a crash or blank white screen is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Dashboards section/browser rendered without crashing
Either a dashboard is shown (panels or a valid no-parts state) or a clean empty browser state
No crash, raw error, or blank white screen
